audit.whatIsWrong: Graded EVEN at 6/10 while the content layer says levels 2 through 6 and the late game are all hers, and Aurora sits at 45.45% over 55 games.
audit.why: Five of the seven stages belong to Neeko once the chart matches the packet.
audit.corrected: diff TRICKY, diffRating 7/10, breakdown.difficulty and the final rating line updated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere in the full layer.
audit.why: Tangle-Barbs is 12/11.5/11/10.5/10s at 1000 range; Pop Blossom is 120/105/90s at 600 range; Blooming Burst is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s at 800 range; Shapesplitter is 16/15/14/13/12s. Those numbers turn "trade on her cooldown" into a real instruction.
audit.corrected: Added to breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and the level 6 phase.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[5] and dosFull[0] describe Tangle-Barbs only as "Her root - extends through targets", which is vague, and nothing on the page states the range relationship between the two pokes or that Pop Blossom wind-up is hidden while she is disguised.
audit.why: Riot: Tangle-Barbs "damages and roots everything it passes through" and only grows when it passes through a CHAMPION, so minions neither stop it nor upgrade it. Blooming Burst is 800 range against Twofold Hex at 900, so Aurora out-pokes her Q while losing the E range war at 1000. Pop Blossom: "The preparation is hidden if Neeko is disguised" - that is why the fog pick works.
audit.corrected: report[5], dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns now carry the real ranges and the hidden wind-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill/Aurora/Aurora/Skill/Skill/Aurora/Aurora and contradicted six of the seven content whys as well as the packet chart.
audit.why: The packet chart, identical on the aurora and neeko packets, is Skill/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Neeko/Skill/Neeko - exactly what whys[1] through whys[6] already say.
audit.corrected: Six tokens flipped as one atomic group in both layers, with the corresponding phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neeko is called "he"/"his" in dosFull[1], dosFull[2], dontsFull[0], breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, report[0], report[1], report[3], report[4] and report[12].
audit.why: Neeko is female. It reads as unedited boilerplate.
audit.corrected: Fixed in dosFull[1].d, dosFull[2].t and dontsFull[0].d; the rest are strings shared verbatim across many Aurora matchups and are listed in notes.

edits.before: The hop makes your poke pattern untouchable. Only take the trade when Neeko's Tangle-Barbs is down.
edits.after: Tangle-Barbs reaches 1000, past your 900 Q, and roots you long enough for her whole Q burst.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Neeko must walk into your range.
edits.after: With E and Q online she roots-and-bursts harder than your passive heals back, and the hop cannot outpace a landed root.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Tangle-Barbs's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Her root keeps setting up trades your poke loses, and you cannot all-in into a 1000-range CC that lands before W resets.

edits.before: Between the Worlds zones the whole all-in — fights inside it are yours. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Neeko's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Pop Blossom dashes in and AOE-stuns on a 120s cooldown — with Across the Veil down there is no dodge and the burst just kills you.

edits.before: Riftmaker is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Tangle-Barbs's cooldown.
edits.after: Riftmaker sharpens your Q-recast — your one even window, if no clone is up and her E is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your pattern is at full power. Neeko carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Full-AP Neeko picks you from fog with Pop Blossom the moment Across the Veil is down — her picks out-scale poke.

edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — Her root — extends through targets. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tangle-Barbs: matchup-defining — 12s at rank 1, 1000 range, and minions do not stop it. - Pop Blossom: 120s at rank 1, and the wind-up is hidden while she is disguised. - Between Worlds: kill windows only.

edits.after: 1000 range on a 12s cooldown, and it roots straight through minions. Bait it first.

notes: Sample is thin - 55 games on the aurora packet and only 15 on the neeko packet - so the TRICKY / 7/10 regrade is Medium confidence and rests on the chart and the prose rather than the win rate. Pronoun boilerplate ("his answer", "he snowballs") still refers to Neeko as male in breakdown.trading, breakdown.feeding, tradeGood, tradeBad, ahead and report[0]/[1]/[3]/[4]/[12]; these strings are shared across Aurora matchups so a global gendered pass would be safer than per-matchup edits. Champion-level: "Between the Worlds" in breakdown.late should be "Between Worlds", and "you are a immobile drain bot" is missing "an". Aurora kit flag misfires: her passive is flagged "anti-heal target" when Riot text says it heals HER, and her R is flagged hardCC when the description lists only damage and slows.
